selector.rationale: Diffuse infiltration by foamy histiocytes, fibrosis, and positive immunohistochemical staining for CD68, CD163, and factor XIIIa support Erdheim-Chester disease, which is further favored by the absence of granulomas and malignant cells.

rejected.label: Rosai-Dorfman disease
rejected.why: Low score and presence of contradicting evidence, including negative immunohistochemical staining for S100 and langerin.

rejected.label: Langerhans cell histiocytosis
rejected.why: Although it has some supporting evidence, the presence of contradicting evidence, such as negative CD1a staining, and the stronger evidence for Erdheim-Chester disease make it less likely.
